excerpts: This was **Washington's** first Thursday night win versus the New York Giants since Week 2 of 2021. This was Washington's third consecutive win against the New York Giants on Thursday night. **Washington** has started the season 2 -2-1 in the division which is their best start against the NFC East since starting 3 -2 in 2024. **Washington** has now played six consecutive games against the Giants without a loss (5 -0 -1). It was the first time since a span in 1981 -84 that Washington has not lost a game against the Giants in six consecutive matchups. **Washington** has gone 1-0-1 against the Giants in a single season for the first time since 1932. **Washington** has won their third consecutive game against the NY Giants on the road, which was their first time accomplishing the feat since 1981-83. **Washington** has secured their first road victory of the season.

recap.paragraph: Jayden Daniels zips a 32-yard touchdown pass to Stefon Diggs with 57 seconds left! Washington takes the lead in New York. Earlier, Cam Skattebo ran for a touchdown to put the Giants ahead. Daniels then found Antonio Williams for a score. J.J. McCarthy hit Isaiah Likely for a 66-yard touchdown, and the Giants led again. But Daniels had one last clutch throw, and Washington won 24-21! It was Washington’s first road win of the season.
